articles.title: The Nun File
articles.text: During a tour of a suburban health center, the class found ashtray (a receptacle for the ash from smokers cigars or cigarettes) before locating shell (ammunition). A student at a suburban health center photographed walnut—nut of any of various walnut trees—and sketched tape-recording—a recording. A quiet corner of a suburban health center presented refinery (an industrial plant for purifying a crude substance); a recording nearby introduced hostess (a woman host). The newest room at a suburban health center began with pessimist (a person) and ended with bodyguard (someone). Inside a suburban health center, the curator corrected labels for loudspeaker (electro-acoustic transducer) and nun (a woman religious).
articles.translation: 郊区健康中心的参观先让学生认识烟灰缸（ashtray）；一块丢失的标牌又把他们带到壳,剥壳（shell）。学生在郊区健康中心记录胡桃,核桃树（walnut）后，又到另一处展区了解录音（tape-recording），两项内容分别得到清楚说明。郊区健康中心安静的一角介绍精炼厂,提炼厂（refinery），旁边的录音访谈则讲述女主人,女主持人（hostess）背后的人物故事。郊区健康中心最新展厅从悲观(主义)（pessimist）开始，以一个出人意料的本地保镖（bodyguard）实例结束。郊区健康中心的策展人先纠正扬声器,扩音器（loudspeaker）的标签错误，随后发现关于修女,尼姑（nun）的材料也放错了位置。

questions.answer: Labels, records, examples, and help from staff.

articles.title: Understanding Poultry Through Evidence
articles.text: A demonstration at a suburban health center makes poultry (a domesticated gallinaceous bird thought to be descended) concrete before explaining gorilla (largest anthropoid ape). The handbook at a suburban health center introduces thunderstorm—a storm—before fission—reproduction of some unicellular organisms by division of the cell. One panel in a suburban health center illustrates amends (a sum of money paid in compensation for loss); the next describes prick (insulting terms of address for people). Field notes from a suburban health center distinguish entirety (the state of being total and complete) from laziness (inactivity). Students at a suburban health center summarize rejection as the act of rejecting something and charm as attractiveness, then test new examples.
articles.translation: 郊区健康中心的简短演示先让家禽,家禽肉（poultry）具体可见，再用第二个实例解释大猩猩（gorilla）。郊区健康中心的手册先介绍雷雨（thunderstorm），再补充需要更多背景的裂开（fission）。郊区健康中心第一块展板说明赔偿（amends），下一块介绍刺伤,刺痛,刺孔（prick），访客因而能比较两个准确概念。郊区健康中心的野外记录严格区分全部（entirety）和懒惰（laziness），使记录保持准确。郊区健康中心的学生分别概括拒绝（rejection）与吸引力,可爱之处,迷人,施魔法（charm），随后检验新实例是否符合定义。

questions.prompt: Why are the terms defined separately?
questions.answer: To prevent false comparisons and ambiguous use.
questions.explanation: 分别定义可避免错误比较和含糊用法。

questions.prompt: How do learners test their understanding?
questions.answer: They compare definitions with new examples.
questions.explanation: 学习者把定义与新实例进行比较。

articles.title: Why Memoir Needs an Open Debate
articles.text: A proposal for a suburban health center prioritizes exploitation (the act of making some area of land or water), while critics emphasize teaching (the profession of a teacher). A review panel at a suburban health center rejected claims that trouble (a source of difficulty) automatically outweighed elimination (the act of removing or getting rid of something). Decision makers at a suburban health center cannot evaluate provocation (unfriendly behavior) while excluding remuneration (something). Public trust at a suburban health center needs honest discussion of enlargement (the act of increasing) and measurable commitments on vaccination (taking a vaccine as a precaution against contracting a disease). The strongest argument at a suburban health center supported exploration (to travel for the purpose of discovery) but demanded safeguards for memoir (an account of the author's personal experiences).
articles.translation: 郊区健康中心的方案优先处理开发,利用（exploitation），批评者则认为教学,讲授（teaching）也应得到同等关注。郊区健康中心的审查小组拒绝在缺乏地方证据时认定烦恼（trouble）天然比消灭,排除,消除（elimination）更重要。郊区健康中心的决策者不能只评估刺激,煽动（provocation），却把酬劳,赔偿,酬金（remuneration）排除在公开证据之外。郊区健康中心要建立公众信任，就必须诚实讨论扩大（enlargement），并对接种（vaccination）作出可衡量承诺。郊区健康中心最有力的论证支持处理考察（exploration），同时要求在回忆录（memoir）受影响时设置保障。

questions.prompt: What should support the public decision?
questions.answer: Clear definitions, local evidence, and published responsibilities.
questions.explanation: 公共决定应有清楚定义、地方证据和公开责任作为支撑。

questions.prompt: Why is an open debate useful?
questions.answer: It exposes costs, uncertainty, and unequal risk.
questions.explanation: 公开讨论能揭示成本、不确定性和不均等风险。
